capture_rule: Capture the complete primary open article and complete supplementary-information record for The isomer distribution of C6H6 products from the propargyl radical gas-phase recombination investigated by threshold-photoelectron spectroscopy, DOI 10.1038/s42004-024-01239-7. Preserve every registered product-channel identity, reported branching fraction or ratio, uncertainty, condition, spectrum, reference spectrum, calibration or analysis disclosure, duplicate or alternative determination, undetected, unresolved, unassigned, adverse and calculated-only record in source order. Do not select by abundance, agreement, detectability, product family, method, uncertainty or interpretation. source_selection_boundary: The DOI-identified complete article and every linked supplement are fixed before either target-bearing full-text record opens, before executable-law registration, before candidate enumeration and before prediction-program construction. The source is selected structurally because it reports a primary experimental same-reaction census of multiple separately identified product channels under held conditions, including the analysis and uncertainty needed to audit complete product support. No observed branching fraction, channel rank, trend, fit or desired agreement selects the source, product row or Fold law.
